entities.name: Szolnok–Kecskemét railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Szolnok–Kecskemét railway is the number 145 line. The line from Szolnok to Kecskemét is 66.0 km long. The first sections of the railway line opened in 1896 between Kecskemét and Lakitelek. The second section between Lakitelek and Szolnok opened in 1897.
